pages.text: Install one Puppet arm and perform its real special action.

pages.title: A Hand in Action
pages.text: Blood and Soul Gems support further puppet modification without granting another finished combat arm.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Whip, Mutant, Blade and Cannon arms are interchangeable. The initial puppet comes from the glove’s native item game in Witch House, not an inventory checklist.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Mutant, Whip, Blade or Cannon arm attachments on the Puppet route. The native tooltips distinguish interchangeable arm attachments and a hostile-puppet Rock/Paper/Scissors interaction.
